names: what CIQ's headline TEV/LTM EBITDA divides is measured only when the comps TEV and the multiple's close (the own-history band's date) are within 4 calendar days; beyond that the block states both dates (dates_differ), an undated multiple states so (date_unstated), and neither divides: no implied denominator, no ratio, no pairing; both renderers print the line for the two readings, and the anchor split's refusal names the two dates, never a pairing (W65: AMZN and GOOGL, 30 days apart)
